review_scope: Bounded public TOGED primary-source pass for national game-industry employment observations outside the already accepted 2023 EGDF/TOGED estimate (10,777). Completed 2026-09-19.

decision.series_action: Retain 2023=10,777 as the only verified TOGED-associated employment observation. Do not add an earlier or later point and do not draw a TOGED time-series segment.
decision.reason: The public TOGED sitemap contained 70 current URLs; a user-agent fetch of every listed page found no national employment headcount/FTE result, no 10,777 restatement, and no another-year workforce estimate. The one TOGED item headed 'İstihdam Destekleri' reports per-person support ceilings, not persons employed. The archived/legacy web results found only qualitative claims about growing employment or training, not an enumerated national workforce stock.

existing_2023_context.unit: FTE-oriented people working in the industry
existing_2023_context.locator: p. 57, 'Employment' column chart, Turkey 2023 bar; questionnaire/method notes in the report define employees, entrepreneurs and in-house freelancers of game-developer studios and third-party publishers.
existing_2023_context.scope_limit: EGDF describes the evidence as a TOGED country answer. The report includes remote employees in third countries when their studio is registered in Turkey and excludes foreign subsidiaries and foreign subcontractor companies. Country sample, gross-up method, reference date and exact FTE conversion remain undisclosed.
existing_2023_context.plot_status: single contextual marker only; no inferred connection to any other Turkish value

decisive_primary_checks.title: TOGED public sitemap and current public pages
decisive_primary_checks.locator: 70 <url><loc> entries retrieved on 2026-09-19; each URL fetched with a standard browser user agent and searched for istihdam, çalışan/calisan, personel, iş gücü/is gucu, employment, workforce, 10.777 and 10777.
decisive_primary_checks.finding: No national employment figure or historical employment table. Search matches were association-team wording, policy text, or the support item separately recorded below.
decisive_primary_checks.assessment: Decisive for the current TOGED public-site inventory at retrieval; it is not proof that no private, removed, or unindexed TOGED report exists.

decisive_primary_checks.title: Ticaret Bakanlığı Desteklerinde 5 Kritik Gelişme
decisive_primary_checks.locator: section '5. İstihdam Destekleri': 'Yurt İçi İstihdam: Personel başına aylık 90.000 TL' and 'Yurt Dışı İstihdam: Personel başına aylık 250.000 TL'.
decisive_primary_checks.finding: This is a description of Ministry wage-support ceilings for international marketing and business-development staff. It contains no count of Turkish game-industry workers, companies, FTEs, or a workforce survey result.
decisive_primary_checks.assessment: Exclude: money per supported person is neither a headcount nor a denominator from which one can derive one.

decisive_primary_checks.title: TOGED homepage / About
decisive_primary_checks.locator: homepage 'TOGED Hakkında' and 'Hedeflerimiz' sections, as indexed and retrieved from sitemap.
decisive_primary_checks.finding: The association says it represents leading game studios and does not admit non-developer companies/individuals as members. It states workforce development as an objective but gives no sector employment count.
decisive_primary_checks.assessment: Membership and policy scope are not a national workforce universe; no observation.

decisive_primary_checks.title: Oyun geliştiriciler teknolojiye de yön veriyor
decisive_primary_checks.locator: section headed 'İstihdam imkanları da büyüyor', attributed to TOGED chair Ali Erkin.
decisive_primary_checks.finding: The attributed statement says export levels and employment opportunities are growing; it publishes no number, reference period, worker universe, survey, or enumeration method.
decisive_primary_checks.assessment: Qualitative corroboration only; exclude from observations.

forbidden_substitutions: Gaming in Türkiye market-report turnover/revenue values, including the nearby 3,300 million-euro turnover figure, are not employment.
TOGED member or studio counts cannot be converted to workers without an original employee enumeration.
Export targets, investment values, policy support limits, training participants and statements that employment opportunities are growing are not workforce totals.
The current 2026 public pages cannot be used retrospectively to infer 2019-2022 or prospectively to infer 2024-2026 employment.
remaining_uncertainty: No original TOGED series earlier/later than 2023 was recovered in this bounded pass. The 2023 EGDF point remains association-backed but has unresolved national-sample, expansion, date and FTE-method details, so it is unsuitable for a continuous trend without a source-native annual series and methodology.
